findings.message: The error from `json.Unmarshal` is ignored, so a malformed or non-array body leaves `names` empty and the handler returns 204 No Content. The client is told the import succeeded when nothing was imported.
`io.ReadAll(r.Body)` reads the entire request body into memory with no size limit. Any client can exhaust server memory by sending a very large body.

Widgets are created one at a time, so a failure partway through returns 500 while the earlier widgets remain created. A client that retries will create duplicates. Consider a transactional bulk create, or report which names succeeded.
